activity.name: Blood Borne Pathogen Risks and Response for Service Workers (US Version)
activity.description: Have you ever wondered what to do if you encounter blood or a sharp object while working? This course equips service workers with the essential knowledge and practical skills to recognize, prevent, and respond to blood borne pathogen risks in non-medical settings. You'll learn about the most common blood borne pathogens, how to spot and avoid risky situations, and the right steps to take if an exposure occurs. Through clear explanations and real-world examples, you'll gain the confidence to protect yourself and others, following OSHA, CDC, and Cal/OSHA guidelines every step of the way.
